seoTitle: CPS Calendar 2027-2028: Start Date, Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: View the CPS 2027-2028 school calendar with official source dates, first day, last day, holidays, breaks, printable PDF and ICS download.
calendarNotes: The CPS calendar from Chicago Public Schools lists 176 K-12 student attendance days for 2027-2028. K-12 students begin classes on August 23, 2027 and end on June 9, 2028, while preschool students begin August 24, 2027 and end June 8, 2028. Winter Vacation runs December 20-31, 2027, and Spring Vacation runs March 20-24, 2028. Parent-teacher conference days are November 2, 2027 and April 13, 2028 and are non-attendance days for students. CPS lists June 13-16 and June 20 as emergency days if student days fall below the state requirement.

calendarFaqs.q: When does CPS start school in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Chicago Public Schools starts the 2027-2028 K-12 school year on Monday, August 23, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CPS Winter Vacation in 2027-2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Vacation runs Monday, December 20 through Friday, December 31, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CPS Spring Vacation in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Vacation runs Monday, March 20 through Friday, March 24, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for CPS in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day for K-12 students is Friday, June 9, 2028.
